Container.Name: Countertop
Container.Overview: An ad-free, always-on kitchen dashboard for the Echo Show 15 (or any wall tablet browser): clock, weather, calendars, grocery list, sports, photos and more. Open http://[IP]:[PORT:8090]/dash on the device and http://[IP]:[PORT:8090]/control on a computer to set it up.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Dashboard, Controls and the phone list page

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, calendar links, grocery list, purchase exports and logs. Create this directory with owner 99:100 before starting. Keep it private.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Your time zone (calendar times are shown in it)
